title: Steam tunnel gates
content: I have mentioned in other places I manage a team in mallworld that manages the steam tunnels that run under the entire city (and possibly the entire continent). We seal up leaks or close and secure doors, whatever. There are walls and gates down there that make navigating really irritating, so like two years ago we wrote some code that allows us to move the gates and walls. Last night I found out something my team has been keeping from me: that software airbrush moves things by manipulating the 4th dimension, which has some unusual side effects effects. When we run the software in auto mode where AI governs everything is fine, but often we run it manually because we have a targeted thing to go do that we don't want the computer learning how to do. Apparently whoever runs the program manually gets shifted in time and space. So like you'll move across the room or into a different office and your age will change. So far they have been covering it by making sure every time we're done we reset everything to exactly where it was so the dude ends up in the right place and the right age. None of that makes sense, but... yeah. If you've ever been in the tunnels and it seemed like stuff was moving that was me and apparently I've been casually risking one of my guys lives by doing it. Gotta love dreams that make you feel like an asshole!
